executive_summary.headline: The practical AI story is governance at production speed.
executive_summary.body: Current video coverage converges on a simple answer: agents create value when teams define outcomes, constrain actions, and measure exceptions before scaling.

executive_summary.headline: Model economics are widening the automation budget.
executive_summary.body: Lower-cost reasoning and stronger open models make more workflows economically viable, but they increase the need for observability and review.
